summary: Preserve export aliases as additional names for the original live binding.

target.notes: No copied value cell should be introduced for the alias.

semantics.alias: same binding under another export name
semantics.liveness: later local writes visible under alias

tests.name: alias tracks local
tests.input:
// a.mjs: let x=1; export {x as y}; x=4
// b.mjs: import {y} from './a.mjs'; console.log(y);

tests.name: multiple exports share binding
tests.input:
// a.mjs: export let x=1; export {x as y}; export const set=v=>x=v
// b.mjs: import {x,y,set} from './a.mjs'; set(9); console.log(x===y,x);
